observations: Microwave oven, silver body with black door window, viewed from front-left angle.
"SilverCrest" brand name visible on the top right of the front panel in photo 0 and photo 1 (both images appear identical).
Control panel is mechanical: one dial labeled 'POWER' and another larger dial beneath it, consistent with a manual/mechanical interface.
Interior shows a glass/mesh plate; no turntable ring or roller visible, so turntable presence is unclear.
Some dust or light staining visible on the top surface and a faint dark mark near the top left corner.
Unit is placed on a wooden stool, not in an active kitchen, with other secondhand appliances in the background (apparent reseller shop setting, watermark 'AMYZAZA KITCHEN AND HOME').
No power cord, rating label, or back panel visible in either photo.
No photo shows the unit plugged in, running, or heating anything.

claims.evidence: Brand name 'SilverCrest' visible on photo 0/1; mechanical dials confirm manual operation.

claims.claim: Control Panel: It relies entirely on a mechanical interface
claims.evidence: Two physical dials (power and timer/defrost) visible on photo 0/1, no digital display present.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or heat (magnetron failure is common in used microwaves and invisible in static photos).
risks.proof: Short video of the microwave running with a cup of water visibly heating, or turntable rotating.

risks.risk: Turntable or glass tray may be missing or cracked.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the interior floor showing the turntable ring and glass plate in place.

risks.risk: Door seal or hinge may be damaged, causing microwave leakage or poor closure.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the door seal/hinge area and a photo of the door fully closed from the side.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a faulty door

risks.risk: Power cord and plug condition unknown (fraying, missing plug, non-standard voltage).
risks.proof: Photo of the rear of the unit showing the cord and plug.

risks.risk: Interior staining could indicate heavy prior use, spills, or rust developing inside the cavity.
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit photo of the full interior cavity.

proof_requests: Video of the microwave powered on, running a timer cycle with a cup of water visibly heating.
Photo of the interior floor showing turntable ring and glass tray in place.
Photo of the rear of the unit showing power cord, plug, and rating label.
Close-up photo of the door seal and hinge.
A photo from a different angle than photo 0, since both submitted photos are identical.
response.reason: The item is clearly a SilverCrest manual microwave oven with a mechanical dial interface, but no photo or video shows it powered on, heating, or with an intact turntable, so it must be priced at worst case as non-functional until proof of operation is given.
